scope: P4.3 English part-B prose for passport shorthand

changes.old: Do not call this a 2026 rate or map it to governorates. | Approx. 23% population geography excluded; >1/4 PSUs replaced
changes.new: Do not call this a 2026 rate or map it to governorates. | The survey frame excludes areas holding about 23% of the population, and more than a quarter (1/4) of primary sampling units were replaced.

changes.old: Do not infer cause or current 2026 gender gap. | Approx. 23% population geography excluded; >1/4 PSUs replaced
changes.new: Do not infer cause or current 2026 gender gap. | The survey frame excludes areas holding about 23% of the population, and more than a quarter (1/4) of primary sampling units were replaced.

changes.old: Do not create governorate-level inclusion maps or describe the wave as complete geographic coverage. | Approx. 23% population geography excluded; >1/4 PSUs replaced
changes.new: Do not create governorate-level inclusion maps or describe the wave as complete geographic coverage. | The survey frame excludes areas holding about 23% of the population, and more than a quarter (1/4) of primary sampling units were replaced.

changes.old: Do not label the ranking as nationally representative for all Yemeni firms. | Not national; some tables have small conditional denominators; obstacle tabulation has filtered denominator
changes.new: Do not label the ranking as nationally representative for all Yemeni firms. | The survey is not national; some tables rest on small conditional bases, and the finance-obstacle table uses a filtered base.

changes.old: Do not state 91.84% of all Yemeni firms face major/moderate finance obstacles. | Not national; some tables have small conditional denominators; obstacle tabulation has filtered denominator
changes.new: Do not state 91.84% of all Yemeni firms face major/moderate finance obstacles. | The survey is not national; some tables rest on small conditional bases, and the finance-obstacle table uses a filtered base.

changes.old: Do not infer hawala volume, payment-system settlement or household distribution. | Not payment-system settlement throughput and not directly measured hawala volume
changes.new: Do not infer hawala volume, payment-system settlement or household distribution. | This is an external-sector macro concept, not payment-system settlement throughput and not a direct measure of informal hawala volume.

changes.old: Do not carry the status forward to 2026 without new evidence and do not infer the positive licensed-wallet universe from the negative list. | A dated negative-authority state only. Do not carry status to 2026, infer current operation, or derive the positive licensed universe.
changes.new: Do not carry the status forward to 2026 without new evidence and do not infer the positive licensed-wallet universe from the negative list. | This is a dated list of names declared unlicensed on the source date only. It cannot be carried to 2026, and it shows neither current operation nor which wallets are licensed.

changes.old: Do not call YPCC/FPS/RTGS fully live or infer adoption, transaction coverage, reliability or inclusion effect. | Institutionalization/implementation-state evidence only. Does not prove system go-live, universal participation, reliability, adoption, transaction coverage or inclusion outcomes.
changes.new: Do not call YPCC/FPS/RTGS fully live or infer adoption, transaction coverage, reliability or inclusion effect. | This is evidence of institutional and implementation states only; it does not prove system go-live, universal participation, reliability, adoption, transaction coverage or inclusion outcomes.

changes.old: Do not label the scalar a population, geography, informal-share or coverage conversion. | Component-specific comparability only; sign/scope/method differences remain material.
changes.new: Do not label the scalar a population, geography, informal-share or coverage conversion. | Comparability is component-specific only; differences of sign, scope and method remain material.

changes.old: Do not call E&O hidden remittances, unrecorded capital as an established decomposition, or an observed flow. | E&O is a net balancing residual and cannot identify a missing component or gross offsetting errors.
changes.new: Do not call E&O hidden remittances, unrecorded capital as an established decomposition, or an observed flow. | Errors and omissions is a net balancing residual; it cannot identify a missing component or gross offsetting errors.

changes.old: Do not present USD7.4bn as official or national observed truth, or identify the residual as directly observed informal remittances. | Errors in other BOP components and the E&O assumption load into the remittance residual; informal remittances are not directly observed.
changes.new: Do not present USD7.4bn as official or national observed truth, or identify the residual as directly observed informal remittances. | Errors in other balance-of-payments components, and the assumption made about errors and omissions, flow into the remittance residual; informal remittances are not directly observed.

changes.old: Do not infer BOP transactions from opening-to-closing IIP stock change alone. | Specification is operational; Yemen IIP input positions/reconciliation table are not yet available in the current public evidence base.
changes.new: Do not infer BOP transactions from opening-to-closing IIP stock change alone. | The specification is operational, but Yemen's international investment position inputs and reconciliation table are not yet in the current public evidence base.

changes.old: Do not call the total active users, unique people, a national inclusion rate or a current 2026 level. | Accounts are not unique people or automatically active; 23% is a source average, not provider-specific/current.
changes.new: Do not call the total active users, unique people, a national inclusion rate or a current 2026 level. | Accounts are not unique people and are not automatically active; the 23% is a source-wide average, not a provider-specific or current rate.

changes.old: Do not infer unique users, merchant ecosystem coverage, household welfare, causality or durable inclusion. | Transaction value is not unique users, merchant adoption, welfare or durable inclusion; grouping is CauseWay-derived, not source-native.
changes.new: Do not infer unique users, merchant ecosystem coverage, household welfare, causality or durable inclusion. | Transaction value is not unique users, merchant adoption, welfare or durable inclusion; the grouping is this resource's own, not the source's classification.

changes.old: Do not infer a 2026 national gender gap, rural access rate, or local service availability. | Not national adult prevalence; not current geography; not comparable to Findex without universe/method bridge; 611-user survey has different sample composition.
changes.new: Do not infer a 2026 national gender gap, rural access rate, or local service availability. | This is not national adult prevalence and not current geography; it is not comparable with Findex without a bridge between their populations and methods, and the 611-user survey has a different sample composition.

changes.old: Do not call this primary-verified, a 2026 level, unique households or a national adult financial-inclusion rate. | Primary 2023 source object and universe bridge are not yet available for direct verification; cannot be treated as 2026 or as population prevalence
changes.new: Do not call this primary-verified, a 2026 level, unique households or a national adult financial-inclusion rate. | The primary 2023 source and the bridge between provider coverage across periods are not yet available for direct verification; the figure cannot be treated as a 2026 level or as population prevalence.
